---
title: "Radio Club meeting times, all are welcome!"
subtitle: "Lower Murray Radio Club — VK5ALM"
---

Our Radio club (which is affiliated with the Adelaide Hills Amateur Radio Society) meets at **7:00 p.m. on the second and fourth Wednesdays** each month at the "Combined clubs" in Johnstone Park, Murray Bridge.

The entrance to Johnstone Park, which houses our club rooms, is at **12 Thomas Street, Murray Bridge**. Anyone with an interest in radio communications is welcome.

We look forward to seeing you there!

## VK5RDM Repeater

- Output Tx **439.850 MHz**
- Input Rx **434.850 MHz** (No CTCSS tone)

See the [VK5RDM MMDVM page](projects/vk5rdm.qmd) for hardware notes and [codeplugs](projects/vk5rdm-codeplugs.qmd).

## Support the Wireless Institute of Australia

- Amateur Radio magazine
- Advancing and protecting our licence privileges
- Protecting our radio spectrum
- National ham radio news service
- Technical reference material for hams

[Visit the WIA](https://www.wia.org.au)

This club is affiliated with [AHARS](https://www.ahars.com.au/).
